title: Archiver
description: Archiver - hold other people's posts and files so they survive their device going offline, and answer 'where can I find npub X'.
summary: Two offers, granted and revoked separately. Storage holds other people's bytes: a quota you set (zero by default, because silence is not consent), what it accepts, and everything held for others with a Drop on every row - a quota is a ceiling, not a target, and nothing of yours is ever evicted to make room. Directory holds only pointers, which is a phone book rather than a library: it remembers WHERE things are and stores no one else's content, so one that vanishes costs the network a directory rather than an archive. Both show exactly what they are doing for the network before they ask you for anything.
